services.desc: Have you ever daydreamed of spending time exploring the Jersey Shore with an adventure that you view as something not within your reach… or an adventure that you think doesn’t exist? Or better yet, spending time with family and friends watching the shoreline go by from the water as opposed to the other way around? How about a day filled with beach combing, collecting seashells… or lunch on the boat with the salty wind in your hair exploring our beautiful shore from the outside in? Do you have a daydream you would like to fulfill? If so, let Beach Hut Sailing Adventures create your daydream for you and make memories that last a life time.
